intent: A tpunit fixture testing JSON::Value's construction, type checking, array/object containers, indexing, merge/path access, cast operators, and copy/move/alias semantics.

objects.name: JSONValueTest
objects.role: tpunit::TestFixture grouping test methods for JSON::Value

objects.name: JSONValueTest::setBool/setBool2/setInt/setInt2/setBigInt/setDouble/setString
objects.role: operator= assigning native types; checks type()/serialize()

objects.name: JSONValueTest::ctorNull/ctorBool/ctorBool2/ctorInt/ctorInt2/ctorBigInt/ctorDouble/ctorString
objects.role: equivalent construction via constructor overloads

objects.name: JSONValueTest::simpleArray/emptyArrayAccess/nestedArray
objects.role: array push_back/indexing/back(), NotFound on empty/out-of-range

objects.name: JSONValueTest::simpleObject/nestedObject
objects.role: object assignment; nested Value assigned by copy, not aliased

objects.name: JSONValueTest::invalidIndex/invalidKey
objects.role: NotFound on bad index/key; mutable auto-vivifies a key, const does not

objects.name: JSONValueTest::extractString
objects.role: extractStringWithDefault pop-and-default semantics

objects.name: JSONValueTest::concatenateArrays
objects.role: arrayInsert range concatenation

objects.name: JSONValueTest::arbitraryDS
objects.role: Value::fromDataStructure() building JSON from native map/set containers, incl. de-duplication via set

objects.name: JSONValueTest::merge
objects.role: merge()'s shallow key overwrite, as opposed to mergeDeep

objects.name: JSONValueTest::getAtPath
objects.role: getValueAtPath() dotted nested lookup incl. missing paths

objects.name: JSONValueTest::serializeEmptyString
objects.role: empty-string serialize invariant

objects.name: JSONValueTest::castOperators
objects.role: implicit cast operators and fill() out-param overload; TypeError on incompatible cast

objects.name: JSONValueTest::operatorThrows
objects.role: exact exception message contract across operator[]/hasMember/size, const and non-const

objects.name: JSONValueTest::testSelfAssignment
objects.role: regression guard: obj = obj[key] must not corrupt or crash

objects.name: JSONValueTest::hasIndex
objects.role: array bounds-check helper; TypeError on non-array

objects.name: JSONValueTest::convenienceCasts
objects.role: Value::object()/singleItemArray() factory helpers avoiding brace-init ambiguity

objects.name: JSONValueTest::operators
objects.role: operator[] semantics: copy-on-assign isolation, auto-vivified null, r-value overloads move rather than copy

objects.name: JSONValueTest::shallowCopyValue/shallowCopyToKey/preventTypeChangeInShallowCopy
objects.role: shallowCopy() aliasing semantics and the guard against changing a wrapper's type via shallowCopy

objects.name: JSONValueTest::getBoolFromBinaryIntOrBool
objects.role: strict 0/1-only bool coercion for signed/unsigned ints, bools, and parsed values

objects.name: __JSONValueTest
objects.role: self-registers the fixture with tpunit at static-init time

name_fit.note: Named for exactly what it tests: JSON::Value

naming_quality.note: Consistent camelCase scenario names; testSelfAssignment is the only one prefixed with test while siblings aren't
